outer.color_note: Weight 5 kg (manual Table 3-5; product page 'Weight: 5 kg'). OVC is a cylinder with four radial window ports and one axial port on the bottom; LN2 fill/exhaust ports and exhaust needle valve on the top plate. Outer finish colour not published.

stages.name: LN2 reservoir (1.2 L, surrounds heat exchanger support tube)
stages.quote: Liquid Nitrogen capacity 1.2 L ... Hold time at 77 K >15 hrs

stages.name: Heat exchanger / sample stage (capillary-fed from reservoir, 20 ohm heater + PT100)
stages.quote: Liquid nitrogen is supplied to the heat exchanger through a capillary tube connected to the reservoir. The flow of liquid is aided by gravity, but the flow rate is controlled by the exhaust valve

stages.name: Charcoal sorb on reservoir (150 ohm regeneration heater)
stages.quote: the vacuum is maintained by a small sorption pump fitted to the reservoir. This sorb continuously pumps the residual gases from the OVC

sample_space.shape: cylindrical vacuum space at window height, 20 mm max sample diameter; holder 20 mm x 50 mm bolted with three M3 bolts to the sample stage
sample_space.description: Sample in OVC vacuum on a holder thermally linked to the LN2-fed heat exchanger, at the level of the four radial windows; a 16-pin Harwin pin ring sits above the holder. Standard holders: plain reflectance and transmission (15 mm aperture).

diameter_or_width.quote: Maximum sample space 20 mm diameter 20 mm diameter; Sample holder dimensions 19 mm wide x 30 mm long 20 mm wide x 50 mm long

wiring.from: experimental 10-pin connector on OVC top plate
wiring.to: 16-pin Harwin pin ring above the sample holder (pins 1-10 used; 2x 34 SWG Cu, 8x 40 SWG Cu)
wiring.quote: The experimental connector is wired to the Harwin pin ring above the sample holder. The pin configuration for the 16-pin Harwin pin ring is shown in Figure 3-4.

windows.quote: Every cryostat is supplied with 4 x Spectrosil WF windows, fitted radially, and 1 x blank fitted axially. ... Optimised clear beam throughput (15/35 mm diameter aperture for DN and DN-V configurations respectively)

moving_parts.quote: The cryostat's liquid nitrogen is stored in a reservoir ... the flow rate is controlled by the exhaust valve at the top of the cryostat.
moving_parts.rate: continuous; 1.2 L reservoir lasts >15 h at 77 K

moving_parts.quote: Liquid nitrogen is supplied to the heat exchanger through a capillary tube connected to the reservoir. The flow of liquid is aided by gravity
moving_parts.rate: gravity-fed capillary flow, set by exhaust needle valve (quarter to half a turn open)

notes: Sources: Optistat DN-V Operators Manual Issue 2.0 (fetched 2026-10-31, text cached at research/v5/cache/cc66df633f2a016a.txt; robots.txt blocked the snapshot script so the PDF was fetched with WebFetch and text-extracted); Optistat family brochure (research/v5/cache/c73e273061693731.txt); QD-Oxford product page (research/v5/cache/295cbbaf14723ca3.txt) which also states 'Weight: 5 kg', '35 mm diameter window aperture', 'System Cooldown: ~ 20 Minutes to 77 K'. Standard config: 4 radial Spectrosil WF windows + 1 axial blank, f/1.0, 10 DC wires (order code 100); optional 2 coax (code 002) not included. OVC pumped by customer pump via DN16NW port to <1e-4 mbar then held by charcoal sorb; no mechanical cooler, no moving cold head; the only motion is LN2 boil-off vapour from the exhaust valve and gravity-fed LN2 capillary flow. 500 K operation requires sapphire windows.
